question: Should gateway v2026.7.1 be promoted as the Windows setup LKG despite the unresolved upstream startup report and absence of current-head Windows setup acceptance proof?
rationale: The one-line implementation is correct, but declaring a release last-known-good requires human release judgment about the reported failure’s applicability and the acceptance evidence.

options.title: Defer v2026.7.1
options.body: Keep 2026.6.11 pinned until the startup regression is resolved or proven inapplicable and the Windows setup acceptance path passes.

options.title: Accept with scoped proof
options.body: Merge only if a release owner documents why the upstream failure does not affect supported Windows/WSL setup and supplies current-head acceptance evidence.

recommendation.title: Defer v2026.7.1
recommendation.body: Keep 2026.6.11 pinned until the startup regression is resolved or proven inapplicable and the Windows setup acceptance path passes.

likelyOwner.reason: He signed the candidate release and is the strongest available release-validation routing candidate.
